subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` attempt reattach-and-replay before its established isolated embedded fallback after an accepted Gateway run disconnects, and what must happen if that recovery remains indeterminate?
rationale: This is a user-visible compatibility decision affecting command latency, stdout behavior, duplicate tool/model effects, and possible delivery semantics; source review cannot choose that tradeoff on behalf of product owners.

options.title: Approve recovery-first with isolated fallback
options.body: Recover the authoritative Gateway result first, then retain the current isolated embedded fallback only after bounded recovery cannot establish a terminal outcome.

options.title: Keep immediate isolated fallback
options.body: Retain the current rerun-first behavior and close or narrow this PR to avoid changing disconnect semantics.

options.title: Use fail-closed ambiguity handling
options.body: Stop after bounded recovery unless an explicit rerun flag is supplied, with clear CLI messaging and compatibility documentation.

recommendation.title: Approve recovery-first with isolated fallback
recommendation.body: Recover the authoritative Gateway result first, then retain the current isolated embedded fallback only after bounded recovery cannot establish a terminal outcome.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the merged fresh-session fallback behavior whose contract is being changed.
